**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Pin manual inventory runs to main**

For a `workflow_dispatch` run launched against a non-main ref, `actions/checkout` checks out that selected ref because no `ref` is specified. findings.reviewer_claim:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Give reruns a new export branch**

When a failed or incomplete workflow is re-run, GitHub's `run_id` does not change ([GitHub context documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/contexts#github-context)), so this reuses the branch created by the first attempt. Because the exporter embeds fresh timestamps, the rerun creates a sibling commit from the same audited checkout, and the unforced push is rejected as non-fast-forward ([git-push documentation](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-push#Documentation/git-push.txt---force)); include `github.run_attempt` in the branch name or safely update the existing branch.
